panels.description: Formal Charter House review chamber, continuous with Page 45: pearl-white institutional architecture, a long elevated review bench, restrained jade-teal, amber-orange and steel-violet accents, and a central table holding the compact purifier. Alex stands at the near side of the table with Ada and Bi11bot behind him as quiet supporting figures; generic House representatives sit above the chamber. Keep the upper quarter and upper-left quadrant clear and uncluttered for the review chair's long speech balloon.

Alex refuses a glowing signature pad on the review table, his open hand stopping just short of it. Lina stands beside the compact purifier. The other contributors are shown only as cropped work-worn hands and partial sleeves at the frame edges, with no crowded lineup or extra faces. Leave the entire upper half open for two separate Alex balloons: the first upper-left and the longer attribution balloon upper-right, with a clear gap between them and both tails pointing to Alex.

Director Cassian Lock stands on the left side of the compact purifier and Alex stands on the right, facing one another across the table in the same review chamber. Lock is a composed adult man in his late forties to early fifties, tall and lean, with silver at his temples, pale olive skin, close-trimmed dark-and-silver hair, light grey eyes and a calm, narrow face; he wears a charcoal suit with a platinum-grey shirt, polished dark shoes and no House crest or insignia. Alex remains tense but steady. Keep the upper-left open for Lock's balloons and the upper-right open for Alex's replies, with separate vertical levels and a broad empty channel between them so the balloons cannot overlap. Keep the purifier and both figures unobstructed below.

Large table-level close view of the worn palm-sized bronze Maker's Seal with its open-hand symbol, held in Lina's hand beside the compact purifier. Five contributor hands press deliberately beside it: Alex's grease-marked mechanic hand, Lina's technical hand, Suri's narrow researcher hand, Jalen's hand beside a diagnostic tablet, and Ren's broad fabricator hand in a reinforced glove. Do not show a crowded lineup of faces. A translucent shared provenance record stabilizes above the table with room for five credited names to be lettered later. Keep the upper-left quadrant clear for Bi11bot's balloon and the lower-right quadrant clear for the long closing caption; the Seal remains with Lina and does not transfer ownership.

items.speaker: REVIEW CHAIR
items.text: The estate of Adrian Phantum. Director Lock advises a signed administrative transfer is ready. Mr. Phantum, do you accept?

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: No. The estate isn't mine to transfer. It never was mine alone to begin with.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: Dr. Lina Vey. Suri Anik. Jalen Orr. Ren Okafor. They built what my father started. I just built what none of us had built yet.

items.speaker: LOCK
items.text: You're refusing a guaranteed purchase in exchange for what? Hundreds of small companies that don't even exist?

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: Not refusing the value. Changing how we create it.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: The people who built them. Together. We license the technology to people who want to start businesses, and earn royalties when they're successful.

items.speaker: BI11BOT
items.text: Well. It recognized the people who built it.
It hadn't woken for a signature, or a claim, or a name on a patent. It had woken for five names, spoken aloud, by someone who didn't need to be the only one who mattered.
